thread:
maria: Hey team — my PR #842 (migration guide) is blocked by docs-preview CI. Two failures: spellcheck + vale style. Need a quick triage so we can merge before EOD. @kate @tom @eng-release
ci-bot: docs-preview job failed for commit 3f7a2b. Logs: http://ci.internal/builds/842 (status: FAILURE)
mar ia: Error excerpt: ```
Spellcheck: possible_misspelling: 'congif' -> 'config' (file: docs/migrate.md:42)
Vale: docs/style/README.Glossary -> Sentence case expected at header 'API keys usage' (file: docs/migrate.md:10)
Linkcheck: Broken link https://old.docs.redwood.ai/sdk -> 404
```
tom: I can take a look in ~30m. Quick thought: link -> old domain is probably failing linkcheck; update to /sdk-v2 or canonical docs link.
maria: I can patch typos and header case right now, pushed a fix branch `pr/842-fix-lint` with three small commits. Can someone review?
kate: I pulled the branch. Vale also flags a PassiveVoice rule in an example comment ("was called"). That one's annoying because it's in a code block.
jess: We try not to disable style rules for single lines — docs-preview doesn't honor in-line nolint. Two options: reword the comment or move the sentence out of the fenced code block.
maria: pushed another commit replacing "was called" -> "calls the client" and fixed `congif` -> `config`. Also updated header `API keys usage` -> `API key usage` to satisfy Sentence case.
ci-bot: Re-running docs-preview for commit 3f7a9d... queued.
docs-bot: Note — linkcheck still reports the old domain in docs/migrate.md: replace https://old.docs.redwood.ai/sdk with https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk-v2 (we no longer redirect in preview env).
maria: updated link to https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk-v2 and pushed 3f7aa4. Sorry for the churn.
ci-bot: docs-preview finished: FAILED. Remaining error: Vale -> Style/PassiveVoice in docs/examples/auth.md (line ~27) — appears to be a sentence inside a comment in an example snippet.
mar ia: argh that file is from an upstream copy. I can rephrase the comment but it's a lot of tiny changes. If we rephrase to active voice it should clear.
tom: If you want I can propose the minimal wording change and ship it. Otherwise we can mark this as a docs-only cosmetic failure and ask @eng-release for an expedited merge after 1 approver.
eng-release: We can proceed with expedited merge only if: CI failures are documented and cosmetic, a reviewer has signed off, and no broken links remain. Please add a short PR description note listing the failing rule and why it's cosmetic. I'll take action when you ping me.
maria: pushed final wordsmith commit to examples/auth.md -> 3f7ab7. Ran docs-preview; queued.
ci-bot: docs-preview: SUCCESS for commit 3f7ab7.
tom: LGTM. @eng-release you have approval from docs owners.
eng-release: Merging now. Reminder: if CI flakes again, we'll revert and open a follow-up. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks everyone! lesson: avoid passive comments in code samples and prefer canonical docs links in migration guides.
jess: Nice work. Quick checklist for future PRs: run `make lint-docs` locally, search/replace old.docs.redwood.ai, and run Vale locally `vale docs/` to catch PassiveVoice.
maria: will do. Closing the loop — PR merged and published to staging.
